children: Elders' trading multiples are undemanding but the Australian agribusiness needs to rebuild investor confidence to justify a material rerating, Morgans analyst Belinda Moore says. Lowering her recommendation to accumulate from buy, Moore tells clients in a note that next month's annual result should offer insight on Elders' cost base, capital allocation, technology overhaul, and fiscal 2027 earnings growth drivers. More certainty is required on a number of fronts, she says. Moore observes that Elders has fallen short of consensus expectations in recent years, leaving investors wanting proof of execution from its new management. Morgans lowers its target price 8.9% to 7.20 Australian dollars. Shares are down 0.2% at A$6.25.  (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
